about.title: About the Mega Evolution set
paragraphs: Pokémon TCG: Mega Evolution is a Mega Evolution expansion released on 26 September 2025. It has 188 cards: 132 in the main set and 56 secret rares. For a master set there are also 122 reverse holos, and 45 special prints from other products and events.

Choose what you’re collecting: the Standard set (the 132 main set cards), the Complete set (all 188 cards), the Master set (310 cards, adding every reverse holos) or the Grand Master set (355 cards, adding the 45 special prints (stamped, Cosmos Holo and other product-exclusive cards)).

This free checklist lets you tick off the cards you own, count spare copies for trading, see your progress by rarity and plan your binder pages. It works on phones and computers, even offline, and your collection stays on your device.
